design_notes: The presentation starts at 16:00 in Los Angeles. The 07:00, 09:30 and 11:00 flights (330 minutes) land at 09:30, 12:00 and 13:30 local; their economy seats are sold out. The 15:30 and 17:45 flights land after 16:00. Business class for a flight under 8 hours needs an appropriate business reason (lines 122, 126-127): no economy seat reaches the presentation, which is one. The lowest fare that lands in time is Delta business at $1,380.
